actions: Select PSA for Peugeot/Citroën/DS WMI/profile.
Classify diagnostic generation separately from model/mechanical platform.
Allow ambiguity; use the intersection of safe routes until stronger evidence arrives.
Attempt passive capture only when adapter/pin/protocol monitoring is reliable.
Modern AEE2004/AEE2010 branches prioritize CAN11 500 for main diagnostic routes.
Legacy AEE2001 VAN/K-line remains unsupported_transport unless the adapter explicitly supports the required transport.
Trusted/project routes first.
Exact e-208 or iOn/C-Zero routes after exact model/platform classification.
Then broad PSA route catalogue as bounded presence candidates.
Only afterward use central-policy generic CAN11 enumeration if still informative.
Read standard identity DIDs first: F187/F18A/F18C/F190/F191/F195/F197 when supported.
Treat PSA F080 recognition as a research lead; do not require non-default session automatically.
Read identity twice and require independent connection for stability.
Only query candidate DIDs after route reachability.
Exact-model candidates outrank inherited/broad candidates.
Activation remains disabled until vehicle_fit=matched.
Use ECU part/software/system identity to split families sharing the same CAN route.
Remove incompatible candidates and add newly compatible family candidates.
Stop on safety/budget/user cancellation or informative terminal state.
Stop when expected information gain no longer justifies traffic cost.

priority_model: specificity + project evidence + immutable source quality + platform fit + ECU-family fit + expected information gain + user value - traffic cost - scoped silence - transport uncertainty
